original_note.en: David and Goliath is the available story. A replay is saved separately from this journey.
original_note.zh: 本版可玩的是大卫与歌利亚的故事。重玩的进度会另外保存。

replay_active_note.en: You are on the replay. Your original journey is saved separately.
replay_active_note.zh: 你正在重玩。原来的旅程另有保存。

start_replay_question.en: Start David's story again from the beginning? Your current journey will be kept separately. You can return to it from this book.
start_replay_question.zh: 从头重玩大卫的故事？现在的旅程会另外保存，可随时从手记返回。

resume_replay_question.en: Continue your saved replay? Your original journey will remain saved.
resume_replay_question.zh: 继续已保存的重玩旅程？原来的旅程会保留。

return_original_question.en: Return to your original journey? Your replay progress will remain saved too.
return_original_question.zh: 返回原来的旅程？重玩的进度也会保留。

journey_error.en: Could not switch journeys. Your current journey is still open; the other save may be unreadable or storage unavailable.
journey_error.zh: 无法切换旅程。现在的旅程仍在；另一个存档可能无法读取，或存储空间不可用。

save_protected_note.en: Your saved journey could not be read. Its files were not overwritten, but progress this session will not be saved. Do not clear browser data.
save_protected_note.zh: 存档无法读取，原文件未被覆盖。本次进度不会保存，请勿清除浏览器数据。
